title: On the distribution of mixed Hodge loci
summary: Let $\mathbb{V}$ be an admissible and graded-polarized integral variation of mixed Hodge structures over a smooth and irreducible complex algebraic variety $S$. We show that if the typical Hodge locus $\mathrm{HL}(S,\mathbb{V}^\otimes)_\mathrm{typ}$ of $\mathbb{V}$ is non-empty, the full Hodge locus $\mathrm{HL}(S,\mathbb{V}^\otimes)$ is dense in $S$ for the Zariski topology.
